readme:
# Emploitic Jobs Scraper Scrape job listings from Emploitic ([emploitic.com](https://emploitic.com/)), a leading job board in Algeria. You get the title, company, wilaya and places, contract type, job level, education level, experience range, work mode, tags, the publication date and the full job text for every job. Turn on the job pages to also get the exact creation and update time, the end of the publication, the number of open positions and the employment type. Search by keyword and filter by sector, wilaya, contract, experience and work mode. ## What you get - One row per job, with ISO dates and the French text kept as the site writes it. - The full job text as HTML and as plain text on every row. Missions, profile, skills, languages and conditions are part of this text; the site does not publish them as separate fields. - Places as a list with the French, Arabic and English names, plus the wilaya of each place. - Experience as the site's range text and as a number of years (minimum and maximum). - Optional job pages: exact creation and update time, end of the publication, open positions, employment type. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. - Anonymous employers are marked with `company_confidential` and have no company name, page or logo. - A run with no input reads the sample: the keyword comptable, 5 jobs. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/emploitic-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `emploitic-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "comptable" (accountant roles in Alger). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "searchQueries": [ "comptable" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as comptable, commercial or ingénieur. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty to read the newest jobs (set `maxResults` or a filter, otherwise the sample runs). | | `sectors` | Business sectors of the company such as Services, Industries or Distribution, Commerce. | | `wilayas` | Wilayas or places such as Alger, Oran, Constantine or Blida. | | `contractTypes` | Contract types such as CDI or CDD Ou Mission. | | `experience` | Experience ranges as the site words them, such as 3 À 5 Ans or Plus de 10 Ans. | | `workMode` | any, onsite, hybrid or remote. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | The filters are applied by the actor to the jobs it reads, not by the site: the saved result pages show no filter parameters in their links, so the actor reads the keyword results and keeps the jobs that match. It reads up to five times more result pages to find them, and only the matching jobs are delivered and charged. A value is matched against the text of the job (sector, places, contract or experience), ignoring case and accents, as a whole word, and a job passes when any value of a filter matches. A value that matches nothing gives 0 jobs. Give a value that contains a comma, such as BTP, Construction, Immobilier, as one entry of a list. ## Sample output ```json { "id": "aa8a012c-7df6-401f-b02e-b0011281f4c5", "alias": "assistante-de-communication-digitale-et-relation-patient-u3y64", "title": "Assistante de communication digitale et relation patient", "corrected_title": null, "job_url": "https://emploitic.com/entreprises/sarl-clinique-draria-sante/offres-d-emploi/services/assistante-de-communication-digitale-et-relation-patient-u3y64", "company_name": "SARL clinique draria santé", "company_id": "bd54b984-82c2-4ab7-a68a-952bb0be61f0", "company_alias": "sarl-clinique-draria-sante", "company_url": "https://emploitic.com/entreprises/sarl-clinique-draria-sante/presentation", "company_logo": null, "company_sector": "Services", "company_confidential": false, "work_mode": "onsite", "remote": false, "contract_type": "CDI", "contract_types": [ "CDI" ], "job_levels": [ "Jeune Diplômé" ], "education_levels": [ "TS Bac +2" ], "experience_levels": [ "3 À 5 Ans" ], "experience_years_min": 3, "experience_years_max": 5, "professions": [ "Marketing, Communication" ], "tags": [ "assistante de communication digitale et relation patient ", "chargée de communication digitale et accueil patient", "sarl clinique draria santé", "..." ], "location_text": "Daïra Draria, Alger, Algérie", "city": "Daïra Draria", "wilaya": "Alger", "wilayas": [ "Alger" ], "country": "Algérie", "locations": [ { "label": "Daïra Draria, Alger, Algérie", "name_fr": "Daïra Draria", "name_ar": "دائرة درارية", "name_en": "Draria District", "admin_level": "6", "iso_code": null } ], "date_posted": "2026-11-10T13:40:15.147Z", "description_html": "

· Animer les comptes sociaux de la clinique ;

· Créer et réaliser des photos, vidéos, réels, stories, visuels et contenus info", "description_text": "· Animer les comptes sociaux de la clinique ;\n\n· Créer et réaliser des photos, vidéos, réels, stories, visuels et contenus informatifs adaptés aux dif", "details_fetched": false, "open_positions": null, "state": null, "expires_at": null, "created_at": null, "updated_at": null, "employment_type": null, "is_expired": null, "search_query": "comptable", "source": "emploitic.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-10T12:00:00Z" } ``` The row above is a job read from the result list; long texts are shortened here. Fields that only the job page fills are `null` in it. ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Id of the job on Emploitic (a UUID). It is the dedup key. | | `alias` | string | URL slug of the job, ending with its 5 character code. | | `title` | string | Job title as published. | | `corrected_title` | string, null | Cleaned title the site derives from the job. Only filled when job page details are on. | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job page on Emploitic. | | `company_name` | string, null | Hiring company. null when the employer is anonymous. | | `company_id` | string, null | Id of the company on Emploitic. null for anonymous employers. | | `company_alias` | string, null | URL slug of the company. null for anonymous employers. | | `company_url` | string, null | Address of the company presentation page. null for anonymous employers. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the company. null when the company has no logo. | | `company_sector` | string, null | Business sector of the company. | | `company_confidential` | boolean | true when the employer stays anonymous. | | `work_mode` | string, null | Work mode as the site gives it: onsite, hybrid or remote. | | `remote` | boolean | true when the work mode is remote. | | `contract_type` | string, null | First contract type of the job, for example CDI or CDD Ou Mission. | | `contract_types` | array | All contract types of the job. | | `job_levels` | array | Position levels asked for, for example Jeune Diplômé or Confirmé / Expérimenté. | | `education_levels` | array | Education levels asked for. | | `experience_levels` | array | Experience ranges asked for, as the site words them. | | `experience_years_min` | integer, null | Lowest number of years over the experience ranges. | | `experience_years_max` | integer, null | Highest number of years over the experience ranges. null when a range is open ended (for example Plus de 10 Ans). | | `professions` | array | Job functions (professions) of the job. | | `tags` | array | Search tags the employer or the site attached to the job. | | `location_text` | string, null | All places of the job as the site labels them, separated by semicolons. | | `city` | string, null | Name of the first place of the job (a city, a daïra or a wilaya). | | `wilaya` | string, null | Wilaya (region) of the first place. | | `wilayas` | array | Wilayas of all places of the job. | | `country` | string, null | Country of the first place. | | `locations` | array | Every place of the job with the names in French, Arabic and English, the administrative level and the ISO code when the site gives them. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Publication time as an ISO 8601 string (UTC). | | `description_html` | string, null | Job text as HTML: missions, profile and conditions as the employer wrote them. | | `description_text` | string, null | Job text as plain text. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | true when the job page was read (includeDetails on and the page loaded). | | `open_positions` | integer, null | Number of positions of the job. Only filled when job page details are on. | | `state` | string, null | Publication state of the job. Only filled when job page details are on. | | `expires_at` | string, null | End of the publication as an ISO 8601 string. Only filled when job page details are on. | | `created_at` | string, null | Creation time as an ISO 8601 string. Only filled when job page details are on. | | `updated_at` | string, null | Last update as an ISO 8601 string. Only filled when job page details are on. | | `employment_type` | string, null | Employment type of the job page data (schema.org value such as FULL_TIME or TEMPORARY). Only filled when job page details are on. | | `is_expired` | boolean, null | true when the site marks the job as expired. Only filled when job page details are on. | | `search_query` | string | The keyword that found the job, or "all jobs" / "filters" when none was given. | | `source` | string | Site the job comes from. | | `scraped_at` | string | Time the row was built, ISO 8601 UTC. | Fields that a job does not show are `null`, and list fields are empty lists. The list shows 5 jobs per page. Fields that say they need the job page are `null` when `includeDetails` is off. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [Bayt Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/bayt-scraper): Jobs from Bayt, the job board for the Middle East and North Africa. - [HelloWork FR Scraper: French Job Listings](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/hellowork-fr-scraper): French-language job listings from HelloWork. - [France Travail Job Scraper - French Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/france-travail-scraper): French public job offers from France Travail. - [Indeed Jobs Scraper - 60+ Countries, $0.06 per 1,000 Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): Indeed jobs in over 60 countries. ## FAQ **Which filters can I combine?** All of them. A job must match the keyword and every filter you set. Each filter accepts several values, and a job passes a filter when any of its values matches. **Does a run with no keyword and no filter work?** It reads the sample: the keyword comptable and 5 jobs. To list the newest jobs without a keyword, set `maxResults` or at least one filter. **Why are many company fields empty?** Some employers stay anonymous on Emploitic. Their rows have `company_confidential` set to true and no company name, id, page or logo. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/emploitic-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
